excluded.test: machine.test.ts > machine > machine.states > should properly register machine states
excluded.reason: inspects Object.keys(machine.states), the declared child state names; no query exposes a state node's full child key list

excluded.test: machine.test.ts > machine > machine.events > should return the set of events accepted by machine
excluded.reason: inspects machine.events, every event type declared anywhere in the machine; no query exposes that aggregate, only per-snapshot queries (next_transitions, can)

excluded.test: machine.test.ts > machine > machine.config > state node config should reference original machine config
excluded.reason: asserts that a state node's config is the same object as the matching member of machine.config and that writing meta through one shows in the other; object identity and mutating a created machine's config are not in the oracle's record (the definition is a serialized copy) and no step writes to a created machine. It would need a step that mutates a state node's config after creation and a reference comparison, which xstate, holding its own parsed definition rather than the caller's JSON, has no counterpart of

excluded.test: machine.test.ts > machine > machine.provide > should override an action
excluded.reason: machine.provide is out of scope; it would need a step that replaces a machine's named action implementation before its actor is created, and a count of each implementation's calls

excluded.test: machine.test.ts > machine > machine.provide > should override a guard
excluded.reason: machine.provide is out of scope; it would need a step that replaces a machine's named guard implementation before its actor is created, and a count of each implementation's calls

excluded.test: machine.test.ts > machine > machine.provide > should not override context if not defined
excluded.reason: machine.provide is out of scope; it would need a step that derives a machine with machine.provide({}) and starts the derived machine in place of the case's

excluded.test: machine.test.ts > machine > machine.provide > should override context (second argument)
machine.test.ts > machine > machine.provide > should lazily create context for all interpreter instances created from the same machine template created by `provide`
excluded.reason: machine.provide is out of scope, the context is a function of nothing (the vocabulary's only context function, context_from_input, needs an input), and the assertion is that two actors' context.foo are different objects, an object identity the oracle's serialized record cannot show; it would need provide, a context function without input, two actors in one core case and a reference comparison

excluded.test: machine.test.ts > machine > machine function context > context from a function should be lazily evaluated
excluded.reason: the context is a function of nothing evaluated once per machine (the vocabulary's only context function, context_from_input, needs an input), and the assertion is that two machines' initial contexts are different objects, an object identity the oracle's serialized record cannot show; it would need a context function without input, two machines in one case and a reference comparison (its toEqual half alone is a machine with a literal context, which other cases already cover)

excluded.test: machine.test.ts > machine > should pass through schemas
excluded.reason: machine.schemas is not part of machine.toJSON(), the only part of a machine the oracle records, and the oracle's setup() passes no schemas (setup replaces a config's own schemas with its own); it would need a schemas field in the case, passed to setup(), and a record of machine.schemas
